cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Let the Callback Claim Credit
cards.instruction: Get recognition by returning to an early overlooked contribution when its importance becomes undeniable.

beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. That strip of tape I added is holding the whole stage curtain up. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Untidiness has just saved the finale.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with the person you asked to remove the tape.
